nodes.label: ADR 0021: Editorial merger stays a facade; edit records live with dictionary models
nodes.rationale: BTEditorialMerger is the right package for consolidating dictionary source blocks, but merge helpers exceed the 60-line budget and BTEditRecord is a domain audit type sitting in a service module. The change is structure only; editorial behavior must not change. Private op collaborators are constructed inside the facade, matching AGENTS.md and ADR 0011's refusal to put Strong/Weak on the constructor. The ADR overrides Trello card Gwr8hysN on injection, a separate models module, an Add class, and a services re-export.

nodes.label: BTEditorialMerger
nodes.rationale: The merger stays the public facade. merge and collect_editorial_warnings remain the entry points. Public seams stay resolver and block_builder. Op classes are built inside __init__ from resolver. _merge_block becomes dispatch plus gender promotion, at most 60 lines, by extracting seed selection and MAIN follow-on assembly. _apply_cross_refs stays on the merger because CROSS_REF is not a BTEditorialOp.

nodes.label: BTEditRecord
nodes.rationale: BTEditRecord is a domain audit type and moves next to BTEditorialOp in wyrdcraeft.models.dictionary. A new models/editorial.py was rejected because it would be one dataclass beside an existing model. A services re-export was rejected because ADR 0011 already deleted compatibility aliases; sinks.py and the editorial merger tests import the model directly.

nodes.label: Editorial op collaborators
nodes.rationale: Substitute, Dele, and Dele-and-add each get a collaborator in editorial_ops.py because those methods are over 60 lines. Add stays on the merger. One EditorialOpApplicator would be the same god object, and an op registry is unnecessary for four known line kinds. Moving a method is not shrinking it: Substitute must split target resolution, sense rewrite, and audit emission. Substitute may mutate a foreign entry, but this landing does not rewrite the foreign block. append_senses is a shared module function used by Add and Dele-and-add.

nodes.label: Trello card Gwr8hysN (editorial merger structure)
nodes.rationale: The card asks for the line-budget split. ADR 0021 overrides it on injected collaborators, a dedicated models module, a class for Add, and a services re-export, using the same override pattern as ADR 0014.
